# Karthik Iyer

> AI Engineer & Data Analyst based in Arlington, VA. M.Sc Data Analytics, George Washington University.

Karthik Iyer is an AI Engineer and Data Analyst with 2+ years putting AI to work for Operations, Sales and Finance teams. He integrates siloed business systems (CRM, finance, workforce, project management) into one ERP-style data layer that agentic AI automations run on, and works across Python, SQL, data modeling, LLM evaluation and sports analytics.

## Experience

- AI Engineer, RestoreFast Operations LLC (Jun 2025 – Jul 2026, North Bethesda, MD): LangChain multi-agent orchestration with RAG, MCP (Xero, Procore) and NL-to-SQL sub-agents; unified 6 business systems into one internal data layer; Pinecone hybrid-search RAG (~30% precision@k lift); Twilio × OpenAI Realtime voice agent handling half of inbound calls; DS-CAR crew recommendation; compliance document hub; Twilio communications layer.
- Performance Analyst (Volunteer), GWU Soccer, George Washington University (May 2025 – Aug 2025, Washington, DC): TITAN player-load dashboards (ACWR, Recovery Index, DSL) and Wyscout/Taka scouting workflows ranking prospects by xG, xT and xA.
- Technical Systems Admin, George Washington University (Aug 2024 – May 2025, Washington, DC): inventory audits, demand forecasting, support-ticket analysis and feedback dashboards.
- Teaching Assistant, Decision Making & Data Analytics, George Washington University (Sep 2024 – Dec 2024): built a Python/NLP/BERT grading-automation pipeline supporting 400+ assignments with human-in-the-loop review.
- Analytics Intern, DPSY & Associates (Apr 2023 – Jun 2023, Mumbai, India): SQL/Python data-quality and reconciliation routines for a banking client (audit cycles cut from 2 to 1.5 months), 10+ Tableau and Power BI dashboards, energy-demand regression modeling.
- Sales & Marketing Operations Lead, TechAnalogy (Aug 2021 – Dec 2021, Mumbai, India): campaign analytics, B2C/B2B strategy and market research.

## Education

- M.S. Data Analytics, George Washington University (GPA 3.68, May 2025, Washington, DC): machine learning, statistical modeling, data engineering, NLP and sports analytics.
- B.E. Computer Engineering, University of Mumbai, SIES (CGPA 3.50, May 2022, Mumbai, India): data structures, database systems, NLP, web development and computer vision.

## Projects

- Laya vs Traditional ML: confidence-gated support-ticket classifier (routed 46% of 16,338 tickets at 96% accuracy) benchmarked against a fine-tuned ModernBERT with temperature-scaled calibration.
- Demand Forecasting: HistGradientBoosting weekly SKU forecasts for 320 products (4-week WAPE 15.2% vs 20.5%) with a Shiny quantile inventory planner.
- Pitcher Perfect: MLB Statcast pitcher profiles over 4.5M pitches with an XGBoost + SHAP Stuff model.
- Action Valuation (VAEP): XGBoost action-value models on 758,434 SPADL events (AUC 0.795).
- [SportSignal – Sports Analytics Hub](https://sports.karthikiyer.info): data platform ingesting five open sports data sources, resolving player identity across providers into a Supabase Postgres warehouse refreshed by scheduled GitHub Actions; 18 seasons of Big-5 European soccer.
- [Understanding Indian EcoPolitical Growth](https://karthikiyer365.github.io/Live/): config-driven R ETL over World Bank, IMF WEO and V-Dem data (64 indicators) feeding a Shiny dashboard compiled to WebAssembly with shinylive.
- [Yelp Analytics](https://github.com/karthikiyer365/DB-SQL-Yelp): Databricks/Spark ETL over 10M+ Yelp data points with AFINN sentiment analysis across 7M+ reviews.
- [WESAD Stress Detection](https://github.com/karthikiyer365/Wrist-Watch-Stress-Detection/blob/main/Wrist%20Watch%20Based%20Stress%20Detection.pdf): Bi-LSTM and CNN-LSTM stress classification from wearable physiological signals with subject-level cross-validation.
- [Sports Analytics Dashboard](https://github.com/karthikiyer365/Soccer-Player-Valuation-with-NBA/blob/main/Soccer%20Player%20Valuation%20Report.pdf): soccer player-performance dashboard and cross-sport (FIFA × NBA) player-valuation model as Dash/Plotly apps.
- [IPL Analytics](https://github.com/karthikiyer365/IPL-Match-Win-Probability-Predictions): ball-by-ball T20 win-probability prediction with 25+ match-state features and an Elo-style team rating layer.
- [Government Employee Salary Analysis](https://github.com/karthikiyer365/Government-Employee-Salary-Analysis): Louisville Metro compensation analysis (2015–2023) from the city's ArcGIS REST API, packaged as a Plotly Dash dashboard.
- Google Play Store Analytics: analysis of 2.5M+ app records with chi-square feature engineering and Tableau dashboards.
- [Crime Risk Modeling](https://github.com/karthikiyer365/Crime-Rate-Prediction---Socio-Economic-Influence/blob/main/Crime%20Rate%20Prediction.pdf): multivariate regression of regional crime rates on socio-economic indicators, with PCA isolating 6 key variables.
- [Audio Similarity Recommender](https://s2t2.github.io/ml-music-2023/): MFCC audio features for 20K+ artists projected with PCA, t-SNE and UMAP to surface artist-similarity clusters.
- Train Scheduling Analysis: hybrid MySQL/MongoDB query layer exposing a ~20% peak-hour capacity shortfall, with Tableau dashboards.
